The 198,759.40 is the Street column 'Debt Service and bond issue cost' (p14, detail index 50), which the governmental funds statement prints as 'Note Payment' (198,759.40) under Other Financing Sources (Uses) (p5; JSON other_financing). Same money printed in different sections by the report; not counted twice in detail, nothing missing.
